summary: Phase 1 MVP backend testing complete for Profit Scout AI. 23/23 new tests passing (100%) for inventory CRUD + metrics, /inventory-meta, CSV export, /stats/home, /stats/sourcing, /stats/reports (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly), /score (Profit Scout Score), /settings round-trip, plus regression for /api/auth, /api/search, /api/profit/verdict, /api/pallets, /api/history. Full suite (including iteration_1 regression) is 39/39 PASS. Math verified exactly: purchase=80, sale=220, fees=29, shipping=9 → total_cost=118, net_profit=102, roi_pct=127.5, profit_margin_pct=46.4. PATCH status='sold' correctly auto-sets date_sold. Settings GET defaults (light/USD/true) → POST {theme:dark} / {currency:EUR} / {notifications_enabled:false} → GET reflects all changes (upsert works). /score returns score 0-100, verdict in {BUY,MAYBE,DO NOT BUY}, all 5 subscores in range, deterministic net_profit and roi_pct math validated, ebay_snapshot keys present. /stats/reports rows[] populated for every period; totals aggregate correctly. /stats/sourcing rows show per-source revenue/profit/roi/items/sold/avg_days_to_sell with best/worst. CSV export returns {filename, csv, count} with header + data rows. No 502s from Gemini observed in this run.

minor.issue: Endpoint returns JSON {filename, csv, count} rather than a raw text/csv response. Request literally said 'returns CSV string'; current shape works for the mobile client (string available under body.csv) but a true CSV Content-Type download would be more REST-conventional. Not blocking.
worst_source falls back to the lowest-profit row even when its profit >= 0 (single-source case). Minor UX nit; behaves fine when multiple sources exist.

action_items: (Optional) Consider returning /api/inventory/export as a true text/csv attachment alongside the JSON wrapper, if any non-mobile client expects a downloadable file.
(Optional) Refactor server.py (~1180 lines) into routers (auth, inventory, stats, score, settings, pallets, scan) for maintainability.
Frontend (Expo) was not tested in this pass per request — main agent has already manually validated screens.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1180 lines and crossing the 700-line guideline — splitting into routers is recommended.
Route ordering correct: /api/inventory/export defined before /api/inventory/{iid}, so /export is not shadowed by the path param.
All MongoDB reads correctly project out _id ({'_id': 0}); no ObjectId leakage observed in any response.
_compute_inventory_metrics handles None sale_price safely (ROI/margin guarded against div-by-zero).
Settings upsert is per-user via {'user_id': user['id']}; defaults returned cleanly when no doc exists.
/api/score uses mock_ebay_data (deterministic) so subscores are reproducible — good for offline/testing.
